# Palo Alto Extraction Remediation Plan

This implementation plan covers the complete remediation of the Palo Alto source parser to use the canonical `ExtractionResult` accounting rather than best-effort "XML -> IR". It enforces the "zero silent loss" principle and addresses known unsafe semantic fallback behaviors (such as inventing `any` or `allow`).

## User Review Required

> [!WARNING]
> This is a major overhaul of the Palo Alto source parser (`src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py`) and its integration points.
> It introduces `ExtractionResult` context and stops treating canonical IR as the *only* source representation.
> Please review the corrected phase order and integration strategies below.

## Open Questions

> [!NOTE]
> None at this time. All previous open questions have been resolved (semantic matrix coverage > branch coverage, and keeping objects parsing within `parser.py` initially).

## Proposed Changes

The work will be executed in the following 20 distinct phases (Phase 0 to 19) exactly as specified.

---

### Phase 0: Safety regression tests
Freeze the current behavior and add failing tests for dangerous semantic issues before refactoring. Add separate test cases for malformed XML (parse/input error), valid XML + unsupported field (`UNSUPPORTED`/`EXTRACT_ONLY`), and valid XML + malformed supported value (`PARSE_ERROR`).

---

### Phase 1: ExtractionResult + source context foundation
Introduce `ExtractionResult` context and source tracking. Ensure the `extract(...) -> ExtractionResult` and `parse(...) -> IRConfig` compatibility contract is respected. Do not modify `__init__.py` unless registration changes. Reuse/generalize existing sanitizer logic where possible instead of writing PAN-specific secret sanitizers.

### Phase 2: Remove unsafe defaults + audit IR defaults + validator/generator safety
Fix P0 broadening behavior (`any`, `allow`, `0.0.0.0/0`, `interface`). Audit and override Pydantic IR defaults (e.g., `IRPolicy.log_end`, `IRNATRule.service`, `IRRoute` defaults) so the parser doesn't accidentally invent semantics. Scan target generators and fix only those that broaden empty/unresolved fields. Update `validators.py` to ensure empty semantics are not re-interpreted as valid defaults.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)
#### [MODIFY] [validators.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/validation/validators.py)

### Phase 3: Device/VSYS/shared scope traversal + scoped resolver
Implement traversal for first-VSYS-only parsing and namespace collisions. Define an explicit object identity strategy (scoped resolver) before canonical generation. Do not silently rename scoped objects unless references are renamed consistently.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

### Phase 4: Real interfaces + zones
Extract real network topology. Do not treat extra IPs as `secondary_ips` unless semantically correct; otherwise store in source metadata. Keep PAN zone type (Layer2/layer3/tap/vwire/tunnel) separate from generic interface types.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

### Phase 5: Addresses/groups/services/schedules/tags/app inventory
Extract objects and groups. Application work is extraction/inventory-first (do not normalize App-ID signatures into generic services).

### Phase 6: Security policies + profiles + default rules
Extract policies with absolute fidelity. Preserve rule order (local, pre-, post-rulebases) and add explicit tests for it.

### Phase 7: NAT rewrite
Define an explicit translation model mapping every PAN source translation variant (e.g. `NORMALIZED`, `PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED`) before coding. NAT rules without SNAT/DNAT are not errors—preserve and classify them accurately.

Split IPv4 and IPv6 routing. Verify routing paths against real XML structures, not just CLI reference documentation.

Preserve policy hierarchy (scope, device-group, pre/local/post, source order). Do not attempt to compute final effective rule order initially.

### Phase 10: Residual rulebase inventory
Extract rulebases and use exact extraction status vocabulary (e.g., `EXTRACT_ONLY`, `VENDOR_EXTENSION`), not generic `UNSUPPORTED`.

### Phase 11: Excel ExtractionResult integration
Ensure Excel generation uses `ExtractionResult`. Reuse existing generic sheets first; only add a generic source inventory sheet if `inventory_items` cannot be adequately represented by existing outputs.

### Phase 12: Web/CLI extraction wiring
Update orchestration to consume `ExtractionResult`. Add a default extraction method to the parser abstraction instead of relying permanently on `hasattr()`.

### Phase 13: Input-format detection/contract
Use permissive extensions for uploads but strictly sniff for XML content. Non-XML content must raise an explicit unsupported-format error.
#### [MODIFY] [parser.py](file:///c:/Users/ziyu.cha-c/Documents/GitHub/firewall-migration-tool/src/fwmigrate/parsers/palo_alto/parser.py)

Update reference validation to be scope-aware based on the PAN hierarchy, not globally by name.

### Phase 15: Documentation

---

### Phase 16: Fixture expansion
Add the necessary focused XML fixtures to `tests/fixtures/palo_alto/`.

---

### Phase 17: Focused regression suite
Run tests targeting only the changed PAN-OS components to ensure the semantic matrix is fully covered.

---

### Phase 18: Full pytest + Excel/manual inspection
Ensure the entire repository's test suite remains green. Manually inspect Excel output to ensure source contexts are faithfully recorded without loss.

---

### Phase 19: Final zero-silent-loss audit
Implement and run a final source-accounting invariant test:
```text
For each recognized PAN source section:
source objects = NORMALIZED + PARTIALLY_NORMALIZED + EXTRACT_ONLY + VENDOR_EXTENSION + UNSUPPORTED + IGNORED_BY_POLICY + PARSE_ERROR
```

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
- Run `pytest tests/ -v` to ensure all existing and newly added regression/safety tests pass.
- Focus specifically on the added semantic test matrix covering P0/P1 edges, malformed XML, valid XML with unsupported fields, and valid XML with malformed values.
- Verify the final source-accounting invariant test implemented in Phase 19 passes.

### Manual Verification
- Review the generic extraction sheets in the generated Excel exports to ensure all raw XML rules and context have been preserved.
- Inspect the CLI execution outputs to confirm non-XML files trigger an explicit unsupported-format error.
